grant_analogue: Overlaps with already funded work / unclear what is new
suggested_fix: State in one sentence what no funded project has done; cite the nearest approved projects.

grant_analogue: Claims larger than the budget, time or method can deliver
suggested_fix: Match each claim to a work package; drop outcomes you cannot measure within the duration.

grant_analogue: Impact or national-priority link not convincing
suggested_fix: Name the beneficiary, the priority theme, and a measurable outcome.

grant_analogue: Problem and approach not justified (why this method, why now)
suggested_fix: Add a short problem-justification section with evidence of the need in Pakistan.

grant_analogue: Literature review thin or missing local/prior-funded work
suggested_fix: Cite previous HEC/PSF-funded work in the area and the gap it leaves.

grant_analogue: Proposal hard to follow: structure, language, undefined terms
suggested_fix: One-page summary first, define terms, objectives numbered, have a non-expert read it.

grant_analogue: No risk analysis, limitations or contingency plan
suggested_fix: Add a risk table: top 3 risks, likelihood, mitigation, fallback deliverable.

grant_analogue: No comparison with the current practice or existing solution
suggested_fix: Add a baseline: what is done today, what it achieves, and the target improvement over it.

grant_analogue: Weak evidence plan: sample, data, evaluation criteria
suggested_fix: Give sample size, data source, and the metric that decides success.
Add a data management plan: what is shared, where, in what format, after how long.

grant_analogue: Pilot-scale evidence for a large-scale promise
suggested_fix: Show a pilot result or a staged plan (pilot -> scale-up) with a go/no-go point.
